rationale: X has a distinctive palette of deep teal, kelp green, cream and orange, a refined display serif, and a specific hero scene with a sensor readout. Its feature illustrations are richer and its section rhythm varies more. Y is competent and also specific, with a conference programme card and a sold-count line in the hero, but its teal-on-navy scheme, plain cards and simpler icons read more like a standard SaaS template.
